profile_text.body:
Accenture plc is a public company listed under the ticker ACN and registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission under CIK 0001467373, with headquarters in Dublin. On its own site the company describes itself as embracing the power of change to create value and shared success for clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities, and says it works across industries and around the world using emerging technologies and human ingenuity.

Much of the site's current material is about AI. Accenture writes about redesigning work and skills so that people and AI work together, about what it calls the Human + AI era, and about AI tokenomics, AI ROI and enterprise AI economics, framing these as ways to connect spending with business value. Other pages address power demand for data centers that it says is pushing beyond grid limits, cyber resilience in an AI driven threat landscape, and a stated confidence among global executives entering 2026 alongside gaps it says stand in the way of scale and value. The site also notes work helping the European Commission's Directorate-General for International Partnerships scale AI across global operations.

No AI products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for the company in the facts held here.
